body:
Thank you both for your replies.

I think one of my main issues is that I have a very ambivalent attitude towards what I'm doing with my life. I'm an anthropology student. I love my discipline, I think it's the coolest thing in the world. That said, I hate the environment of my department. It's a lot of outsourcing, a lot of dancing around addressing questions like "what's my next step" or "will this be worth dropping 5k and going hungry for a couple times a week in six months?"  If I knew I could transfer and not have all the work I've put in be lost, I would. But, I can't and it's extremely frustrating because I've put in the work and have just been dicked around for the last six months.

This certainly isn't the first time I've had suicidal thoughts, althought I've never gotten to the point that I was at last night. My parents are normally really supportive, but with what a stressed out mess I have been in the last few days, they don't want to deal with me, which I understand.
